verdict.rationale: The pack has no published Orrick guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction of incorporation, such as Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd. The closest items are a German incorporation questionnaire form, which is a formation intake tool rather than choice-of-entity guidance, and a community anecdote about Orrick handling a Delaware incorporation as a paid service. Both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
